name: gallery
title: Gallery
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A versatile, multi-variant interactive visual gallery featuring revolving 3D orbit rings, responsive bento grids, vertical continuous reels, 3D pill carousels, and perspective arc carousels. Use it for agencies, portfolios, product showcases, and creative hero sections.
docs: Named export: Gallery (also exports OrbitGallery for backward compatibility). Default export: Gallery. Variants: orbit | bento | reel | pill | arc. Pass items ({ image, alt, title?, subtitle?, href? }), speed/duration, orientation, aspect, autoSlide, and radius/gap options.
